hero.intro: I build resilient backend systems that power thousands of payment transactions. Specialized in NestJS, Node.js, and PostgreSQL — with a knack for turning complex problems into elegant, scalable solutions.

about.label: // about-me
about.title: About Me
about.p1: I've been coding for well over ten years, and about six of those in real jobs. From 2022 to 2026 I worked at Blackthorn.io with the backend as my home base: NestJS services, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis. Most days it was payments and events — keeping that flow steady, watching for regressions, and tightening things before they turned into fires.
about.p2: Backend is where I'm strongest, but in that job I worked across whatever shipped the feature: APIs and data first, and Angular or the rest of the stack when that's what the ticket needed. I still like being with product or support when production acts up, chasing a slow query, or refactoring so the next person who opens the file isn't guessing.
about.p3: I'm paying attention to where AI can cut real repetitive work out of day-to-day engineering — time and steps I actually get back, not another trend to chase. After work, in a totally different spirit, I sometimes build small mobile apps as a hobby. I'm not looking for mobile roles; mobile just feels like the best fit when I'm the only one carrying a project from a small idea to something that runs on my phone.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: Building impactful software across payments, cloud, and enterprise systems

roles.title: Software Developer
bullets: Migrated 48 Salesforce classes (events, tickets, and system data) to external database storage, bypassing governor limits and improving scalability without compromising security policies
Implemented Redis caching system with dynamic TTLs across all non-payment endpoints, reducing large list query response times from 20+ seconds to sub-second
Designed and built purchase funnel analytics using Google Tag Manager, tracking user drop-off points and event engagement to enable data-driven product decisions
Co-created new microservices from scratch within a 10+ repository NestJS architecture, improving service isolation and independent deployability
Provided cross-functional support: mentoring developers, assisting QA team, and handling Tier 3 production escalations
Participated in on-call rotation, regularly resolving critical payment production incidents under pressure

roles.title: Salesforce & Azure Integration Developer
bullets: Built 40+ enterprise integration flows on Azure (Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory, Data Lake), connecting Salesforce with Dynamics 365 and other systems, with end-to-end monitoring via Serverless360
Provided Salesforce CPQ support in client production systems: fixed long-standing bugs and monitored trigger handlers, batch jobs and schedulable processes to keep operations stable

roles.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Built a full-stack graphic resources platform from scratch with an Angular 9 frontend and a Node.js/Express REST API, turning Adobe XD mockups into production-ready interfaces (Bootstrap, Angular Material)
Identified and proposed architectural improvements to key portions of the codebase

testimonials.label: // what-colleagues-say
testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: From people I've had the pleasure of working with

items.text: I had the immense pleasure not just to work directly with Joaquin but to have him as a member of one of my teams during our time together at Blackthorn. I simply cannot express how refreshing it is to work with someone who is so reliable. Even when working outside his wheelhouse, Joaquin was beyond excellent at delivering superb work quicker than I would expect possible. More importantly, his level of communication revealed a true understanding of balancing scope, requirements, and technical feasibility at all points in the lifecycle. If there is ever a challenge or question around a body of work, you will never have to ask Joaquin for more details because he will have already diagnosed the situation and brought you potential solutions.
items.name: Thomas Horsch

items.text: I had the pleasure of working with Joaquin for several years, first as the QA Engineer on his team and later as a Software Support Engineer, and he is one of the most reliable developers I've worked with. His code was consistently clean and well thought out, and when I did find issues, he took them seriously, understood them quickly, and fixed them without friction. When I moved into support, we worked closely again on customer problems that came my way. Joaquin was always ready to dig in, help me understand what was going on under the hood, and find a solution. He explains technical issues clearly and never makes you feel bad for asking questions. Any team would benefit from having Joaquin.
items.name: Jason Arias

items.text: I worked with Joaquin for more than four years at Blackthorn. I was scrum master on his team, and after we moved off scrum I kept supporting his team with standups, updates, and prioritization. Joaquin worked as a full stack developer on the web apps behind Blackthorn's Payments, Events, and Messaging products. He's very reliable. When he needed infrastructure help or a code review from another team, he reached out himself instead of letting the ticket sit, so his work rarely stayed blocked for long. That kind of follow-through makes the people around you better at their jobs too. Any team hiring a backend or full stack engineer would be lucky to have him.
items.name: Lesley Boyd

items.text: I worked with Joaquin at Blackthorn for over four years, and it was a pleasure having him as a teammate. When I first joined Blackthorn as a developer, he was one of the people who helped me get up to speed and was always willing to share his knowledge and help me out. I really appreciated having him as a mentor during that time. He's approachable, easygoing, and always willing to adapt, switch priorities, and take on different responsibilities depending on what the team needs. I'd happily work with him again and would recommend him to any engineering team looking for a great developer and teammate.
items.name: Carlos Mendoza

items.text: Joaquin is out of this world. He has the right skills to propose good solutions, knows how to solve complex problems, and is a full-stack engineer with a lot of knowledge. He interviewed me when I joined Blackthorn, and he designed a very strong, complex project that integrates a PostgreSQL database with Salesforce to calculate rules for permissions in events without using PII, which was a major requirement. I can recommend Joaquin for future projects — he's very capable of creating software architecture from scratch!
items.name: Fernando Zamperin

items.text: I had the pleasure of working with Joaquin at Blackthorn and can confidently say he's a fantastic developer and collaborator. He approaches problems with both technical depth and an architectural perspective, always aiming for robust and scalable solutions. He was always open to feedback, quick to address issues, and proactive in improving the overall quality of the system.
items.name: Franco Bianucci

items.text: Joaquín consistently demonstrates exceptional technical skills and a deep understanding of our industry. His innovative approach and problem-solving abilities have significantly contributed to the success of our projects. He is not only technically proficient but also a fantastic team player. He is always willing to lend a hand, share his knowledge, and collaborate to achieve the best results.
items.name: Hugo Héctor Fernández

items.text: I had the chance to work with Joaquin at Digital Lab, where we both started our careers. From day one, he stood out as someone reliable, easy to work with, and always willing to help. We collaborated closely on several tasks, and I really appreciated how he approached problems — calm, thoughtful, and always looking for a good solution. He's a strong team player and someone you can count on when things get challenging. I'm glad we had the opportunity to work together early on, and I'm sure he'll keep doing great wherever he goes.
items.name: Hernan Llull

items.text: I was lucky to call him my coworker. He consistently gave 100 percent effort to the team and played a significant role in ensuring that we completed assignments on time. Any team would be lucky to have Joaquín.
items.name: Cristian Vizzarri
